entities.summary: San Giacomo di Rialto is a church in the sestiere of San Polo, Venice, northern Italy. The inclusion of Rialto in the name distinguishes this church from San Giacomo dell'Orio which is situated in the sestiere of Santa Croce, on the same side of the Grand Canal. The church's front forms the eastern side of Rialto Square and is one of the only buildings on that square that escaped the devastating fire of 1514 alongside the Palazzo dei Camerlenghi
